name: DN404
summary: The proxy remained uninitialized, allowing the attacker to call its public initializer and then use the resulting authority to withdraw all FLIX held by the proxy.
notes: The seventh and last pre-exploit Upgraded event installed implementation 0xe58acb560fc33e283ab70c700a0f2eed0e333e0a.
The receipt records exactly 685,000 FLIX leaving the victim and the immediate FLIX/USDT swap returning 169,577.736489 USDT; the realized stablecoin proceeds provide the onchain valuation.
